//: OpenBox managed settings for Claude Code (E8-S8). Deploy root-owned and user-unwritable to /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (Linux), /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/ (macOS), or C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\ (Windows). See ../README.md for what each key does and does not guarantee.
//hooks: Admin-defined OpenBox hooks. The binary path below is absolute because a managed hook cannot depend on the provider's working directory; `openbox managed install` fills it in.
//mandate: Without allowManagedHooksOnly a user hook config coexists with this one, so the gate can be bypassed by adding a competing config rather than by editing this file.
//sandbox: failIfUnavailable makes the tool refuse to run rather than silently degrade to unsandboxed; allowUnsandboxedCommands:false makes the per-command escape a no-op.
//permissions: Deny rules that do not depend on OpenBox policy being fresh — defence in depth for the classes the incident record shows matter most (credential exfiltration, remote-piped shell).
//version-floor: Present as hygiene only. Version floors FAIL OPEN upstream (an unmet value is stripped, not enforced) — never rely on this as a control.
